name: Martha's Table Market at The Commons
schedule_note: Weekdays 11am-4pm; closed on holidays (e.g., closed Mon Oct 12, 2026 for Indigenous Peoples' Day). Check marthastable.org/operations for closures. Guests may shop twice monthly.
eligibility: "Guests are welcome to shop twice monthly at our no-cost markets." "All guests wishing to shop at our markets must register for a free membership card." To register bring "Your photo ID OR A clear copy of your photo ID". "Must be 16 or older to shop." Guests may shop for themselves and one other person. Without proper ID you "will receive a fruit bag and be encouraged to return with the necessary documents".
notes: Operator markets page gives address and Mon-Fri 11am-4pm; operator 2026 events calendar lists market dates Sep 28-Oct 30, 2026 at 2375 Elvans Road SE (no market Oct 12). Choice-based no-cost produce and pantry items, first-come first-served. No DC-residency or income rule is stated on the operator page (third-party directories mention proof of DC residence; not confirmed). Phone is Martha's Table main line. Martha's Table also lists a Joyful Food Market for its own early-childhood (ECE) families at this address (Oct 21, Nov 17, Dec 16, 2026). Free food, so SNAP/WIC/Produce Plus are not applicable (set false). Languages not stated (defaulted to en). Ward 8 from DC MAR address point (not stated by the operator).
